Here you go — compact and ready for the bench.

---

## 1. A Natural Minor

**RH melody (eighth notes → half note ending):**

| Note | C4 | E4 | G4 | A4 | G4 | E4 | D4 | C4 | B3 | A3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 3 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

**LH chords:**
- Beat 1: **Am root** → A2 C3 E3 (5–3–1)
- Beat 3: **Am root** → A2 C3 E3 (hold or re-strike)

---

## 2. A Harmonic Minor

**RH melody:**

| Note | C4 | E4 | G#4 | A4 | G#4 | E4 | D4 | C4 | B3 | A3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 3 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

**LH chords:**
- Beat 1: **Am root** → A2 C3 E3 (5–3–1)
- Beat 3: **E major root** → E2 G#2 B2 (5–3–1)
- Final A: **Am root** → A2 C3 E3

---

## 3. A Melodic Minor (ascend then descend)

**RH melody:**

| Note | C4 | E4 | F#4 | G#4 | A4 | G4 | E4 | D4 | C4 | B3 | A3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 3 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 3 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

**LH chords:**
- Beat 1: **Am root** → A2 C3 E3 (5–3–1)
- Under F#4: **D major root** → D2 F#2 A2 (5–3–1)
- Final A: **Am root** → A2 C3 E3

---

## 4. C Natural Minor

**RH melody:**

| Note | C4 | Eb4 | G4 | Ab4 | G4 | Eb4 | D4 | C4 | Bb3 | C4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 1 | 2 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 |

**LH chords:**
- Beat 1: **Cm root** → C3 Eb3 G3 (5–3–1)
- Under Ab4: **Ab major 1st inv** → C3 Eb3 Ab3 (5–3–1)
- Final C: **Cm root** → C3 Eb3 G3

---

## 5a. C Harmonic Minor

**RH melody:**

| Note | C4 | Eb4 | G4 | Ab4 | G4 | Eb4 | D4 | C4 | B3 | C4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 1 | 2 | 4 | 5 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

**LH chords:**
- Beat 1: **Cm root** → C3 Eb3 G3 (5–3–1)
- Under B3: **G major root** → G2 B2 D3 (5–3–1)
- Final C: **Cm root** → C3 Eb3 G3

---

## 5b. C Melodic Minor (ascend then descend)

**RH ascending:**

| Note | C4 | Eb4 | G4 | A4 | B4 | C5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 1 | 2 |

**RH descending (natural minor):**

| Note | Bb4 | Ab4 | G4 | F4 | Eb4 | D4 | C4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finger | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

**LH chords:**
- Beat 1: **Cm root** → C3 Eb3 G3 (5–3–1)
- Under A4: **F major root** → F2 A2 C3 (5–3–1)
- Under B4: **G major root** → G2 B2 D3 (5–3–1)
- Descending / final C: **Cm root** → C3 Eb3 G3

---

## At a Glance: Accidentals Cheat Sheet

| Version | Sharps/flats to remember |
|---|---|
| A natural minor | none |
| A harmonic minor | G# |
| A melodic minor ↑ | F# G# |
| C natural minor | Eb Ab Bb |
| C harmonic minor | Eb Ab + B♮ |
| C melodic minor ↑ | Eb + A♮ B♮ |

Take them one at a time, hands separate first. Have fun with it!
